messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — HIGH severity alert for svc-inference-prod: GPU queue length > 1k and sustained GPU util > 95% for 10m. Autoscaler failed to add capacity (scale_attempts=3, reason=placement_failed). Link: https://dash.redwood.prod/incidents/5387654321

alex.g: saw this spike, end-to-end latency climbing, lots of 503s. Queue backlog spiking + throttles kicking in. Investigating GPU allocation errors in scheduler.

mira_oncall: I'm looking at the allocator logs now. `pod_bind` is failing with "no compatible MIG slice" on many candidates — looks like fragmentation + wrong MIG sizing.

sam: confirming — MIG sizing mismatch. Several hosts show free GPU memory but available slices don't match requests (requested 1g12 but nodes have 2g6 configured). Binpacking can't place small slices.

alex.g: autoscaler logs show we hit `max_pool_size` for the burstpool in us-west-2 (pool_limit=120). Tried cold-add, placement failed, fallback throttled.

ryan_cs: customer-impact: CS reports 4 enterprise customers see 30-60% higher error rates on generation endpoints. Notifying them now with interim mitigation.

karen_prod: which models are impacted? can we route to compatible lower-MIG models?

sam: majority is `text-gen-xlarge` pinned to 2g6 MIG slices. If we can temporarily route new requests to `text-gen-large` (1g12) that would reduce tail latency and use different packing.

mira_oncall: quick triage results: (1) fragmentation+mis-specified MIG profiles, (2) autoscaler stopped allocating due to placement errors, (3) queue growth exceeded throttle thresholds and started shedding requests.

alex.g: immediate mitigation options — pick one:
- force-repack (evict + repack pods to consolidate MIG slices) — risky, could cause transient 5xxs but frees stranded slots
- temporarily relax placement constraints to allow mixed-MIG packing (requires infra toggle)
- emergency scale-up of dedicated hosts (request more quota) — slow (~20-30m)

mira_oncall: I'm going to attempt a controlled repack with small batch evictions (batch_size=20) to avoid total outage. Starting a dry-run to estimate impact. Command:```sh
# dry-run repack
infractl repack --pool svc-inference-prod --batch 5 --dry-run
```

ops-bot: Dry-run output: estimated freed_slices=48, risk_level=medium.

sam: also enabling a temporary autoscaler override to allow 30 additional cold nodes while repack runs: `autoscaler.override --pool svc-inference-prod --add 30 --duration 60m`

alex.g: make sure we update routing to fall back to `text-gen-large` for non-SLA customers during mitigation. Karen, can CS coordinate the list?

karen_prod: yes, I'll post an ETA to affected customers and ask for permission to degrade model for some workloads.

ryan_cs: posted status update to customers and included recommended retry logic.

mira_oncall: kickstarting repack now. Will watch backlog and error rates. If we see error rate > 40% after batch 2, stop and revert.

incident-bot: ACTION CREATED — incident/5387654321/repack-job with assignee mira_oncall. Pager escalation schedule updated.

sam: logs show repack batch 1 completed, freed 12 slices. backlog decreased ~18%. continuing.

alex.g: applying temporary placement-relax toggle to let scheduler accept mixed-MIG placements for 30m. Command: `infractl feature-toggle set allow_mixed_mig true --ttl 30m`

mira_oncall: repack batch 3 finished, backlog down 65%, 503 rate reduced to baseline for most customers. Keeping autoscaler override for 20m to allow cooldown.

karen_prod: good to announce partial mitigation to customers, call it safe mode with degraded model routing.

ryan_cs: customers A and B acknowledged, appreciate fast response.

alex.g: root cause notes to capture: misaligned MIG profile requests, binpacking inefficiency, autoscaler hitting pool_limit + placement failures. Action items: enforce request validation, increase burstpool quotas, improve repack automation, and add early-warning metric for stranded_slices>.

mira_oncall: handing off to night oncall @mira_oncall for monitoring and follow-ups. Summary for oncall: repack succeeded partially, autoscaler override active until +20m, allow_mixed_mig toggle on until +10m, customer notifications sent. Pager cleared for now but watch `stranded_slices` and `queue_length`.

sam: noted. If any re-appears, escalate to eng-runtime and infra immediately.

mira_oncall: taking it, will post a 30m update or sooner if it regresses. :thumbsup:
